sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Original installed Vitest4.1.11 / Node24.19.0 with minimal node config, not the full original config. No aliases, DOM/canvas/host-port setup, feature-wall define, GC/WebStorage flags or extended timeouts. Real-server cases bind ephemeral loopback explicitly; synthetic cases retain original clocks/spies. No original assertions/imports replaced.

Transport package trees are pinned. Optional ws native peers are disabled per child via WS_NO_BUFFER_UTIL=1 and WS_NO_UTF_8_VALIDATE=1; real ws/tweetnacl/zod implementations remain. Native-addon/performance, full config and real SSH equivalence are not established.
isolationRationale: Root read the complete two-case original suite and reread all four runtime modules. Runtime imports require real pinned zod; use existing validated transport package adapter (ws/tweetnacl available but not used by this suite). In-memory handshake/RPC strings and original JSON.parse spy restored in finally; no network or credentials.
testEvidenceBoundary: Original frame parser observations only: valid ready/authenticated/keepalive examples and excessive ready-frame nesting rejected before JSON.parse. Not exhaustive RPC/schema/authentication/cryptographic testing, malformed-auth-null coverage, transport behavior or rewritten-product parity.

dependencyDiscovery.parser: Installed @babel/parser7.29.7; static runtime import/export walk excluding type-only imports
dependencyDiscovery.limits: Discovery is routing only; root read complete source bodies before admission. Versions and tree fingerprints do not alone authorize arbitrary tests.
